about.en: SP500 xStock (SPYx) is a tokenized tracker certificate on SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust, issued by Backed under the xStocks brand. Each token is backed 1:1 by SPY shares held with qualified custodians and tracks the ETF price on-chain on Solana (XsoCS1TfEyfFhfvj8EtZ528L3CaKBDBRqRapnBbDF2W), Ethereum, BNB Chain, Arbitrum and other networks. xStocks are offered to non-US investors.
